mapper.select: SELECT dictionary_data.dict_value FROM sys_dict_data dictionary_data JOIN sys_dict_type dictionary_type ON dictionary_type.dict_type = dictionary_data.dict_type AND dictionary_type.tenant_id = dictionary_data.tenant_id AND dictionary_type.status = '0' WHERE dictionary_data.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dictionary_data.dict_type = #{dictType} AND dictionary_data.status = '0' ORDER BY dictionary_data.dict_sort, dictionary_data.dict_code

choose.when: SELECT CAST(employee_row.id AS CHAR) AS id, employee_row.name AS label, CAST(employee_row.dept_id AS CHAR) AS department_id FROM hr_employee employee_row LEFT JOIN sys_dept department_row ON department_row.tenant_id = employee_row.tenant_id AND department_row.dept_id = employee_row.dept_id AND department_row.deleted = 0 WHERE employee_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_row.deleted = 0 AND employee_row.employee_status NOT IN ('RESIGNED','LEFT','TERMINATED','SUSPENDED') AND (employee_row.dept_id = #{scopeDeptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{scopeDeptId}, department_row.ancestors) > 0) ORDER BY employee_row.id

SELECT CAST(user_row.user_id AS CHAR) AS id, user_row.nick_name AS label, CAST(user_row.dept_id AS CHAR) AS department_id FROM sys_user user_row LEFT JOIN sys_dept department_row ON department_row.tenant_id = user_row.tenant_id AND department_row.dept_id = user_row.dept_id AND department_row.deleted = 0 WHERE user_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_row.deleted = 0 AND user_row.status = '0' AND (user_row.dept_id = #{scopeDeptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{scopeDeptId}, department_row.ancestors) > 0) ORDER BY user_row.user_id

SELECT CAST(dept_id AS CHAR) AS id, dept_name AS label, NULL AS department_id FROM sys_dept WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND (dept_id = #{scopeDeptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{scopeDeptId}, ancestors) > 0) ORDER BY dept_id
SELECT CAST(post_id AS CHAR) AS id, post_name AS label, NULL AS department_id FROM sys_post WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = '0' ORDER BY post_id
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id, position_name AS label, NULL AS department_id FROM hr_position WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id

SELECT dictionary_data.dict_value AS id, dictionary_data.dict_label AS label, NULL AS department_id FROM sys_dict_data dictionary_data JOIN sys_dict_type dictionary_type ON dictionary_type.tenant_id = dictionary_data.tenant_id AND dictionary_type.dict_type = dictionary_data.dict_type AND dictionary_type.status = '0' WHERE dictionary_data.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dictionary_data.dict_type = #{dictType} AND dictionary_data.status = '0' ORDER BY dictionary_data.dict_sort, dictionary_data.dict_code
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS id, NULL AS label, NULL AS department_id WHERE 1 = 0

choose.when: SELECT employee_row.id, employee_row.name, employee_row.employee_no AS employeeNo, employee_row.dept_id AS deptId, department_row.dept_name AS deptName, department_row.ancestors AS deptAncestors, employee_row.post_id AS postId, post_row.post_name AS postName, employee_row.position_id AS positionId, position_row.position_name AS positionName FROM hr_employee employee_row LEFT JOIN sys_dept department_row ON department_row.dept_id = employee_row.dept_id AND department_row.tenant_id = employee_row.tenant_id AND department_row.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_post post_row ON post_row.post_id = employee_row.post_id AND post_row.tenant_id = employee_row.tenant_id LEFT JOIN hr_position position_row ON position_row.id = employee_row.position_id AND position_row.tenant_id = employee_row.tenant_id WHERE employee_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_row.id = #{referenceId} AND employee_row.deleted = 0 AND employee_row.employee_status NOT IN ('RESIGNED','LEFT','TERMINATED','SUSPENDED')

SELECT user_row.user_id AS id, user_row.nick_name AS name, user_row.dept_id AS deptId, department_row.dept_name AS deptName, department_row.ancestors AS deptAncestors FROM sys_user user_row LEFT JOIN sys_dept department_row ON department_row.dept_id = user_row.dept_id AND department_row.tenant_id = user_row.tenant_id AND department_row.deleted = 0 WHERE user_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_row.user_id = #{referenceId} AND user_row.deleted = 0 AND user_row.status = '0'

SELECT dept_id AS id, dept_id AS deptId, dept_name AS deptName, dept_name AS name, ancestors AS deptAncestors FROM sys_dept WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{referenceId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0'

SELECT position_row.id, position_row.id AS positionId, position_row.position_name AS positionName, position_row.position_name AS name, position_row.post_id AS postId, post_row.post_name AS postName FROM hr_position position_row LEFT JOIN sys_post post_row ON post_row.post_id = position_row.post_id AND post_row.tenant_id = position_row.tenant_id WHERE position_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND position_row.id = #{referenceId} AND position_row.status = 1
